name: @hotelos-apps/roomcare-ui
description: Room Care's packaged desktop module — the board, prepare, room states, supervision, deep clean, setup, my rooms and the five widgets.

scripts.build: npm run build:module && npm run build:widgets
scripts.build:widgets: node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/rooms-ready.js widgets/entry/rooms-ready.ts && node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/arrivals-waiting.js widgets/entry/arrivals-waiting.ts && node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/attention.js widgets/entry/attention.ts && node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/attendants-now.js widgets/entry/attendants-now.ts && node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/pending-policy.js widgets/entry/pending-policy.ts
